\ifdefined\GraphFixturePaired\ParallelSetup{single-columns=1}\fi
\newcommand\GraphPair[2]{\ParallelParagraph{#1}{#2}{#2}}

\StudyDeclareGraphNode{get-value}{2}{procedure}{warning}{Obtain the missing value}{Find the absent value}
\StudyDeclareGraphNode{compute-value}{3}{procedure}{action}{Compute the value}{Calculate the value}
\StudyDeclareGraphNode{check-value}{4}{decision}{check}{Check the result}{Verify the result}
\StudyDeclareGraphNode{report-value}{5}{procedure}{result}{Report the result}{State the result}

\ifdefined\GraphFixtureReader\StudyGraphReaderProfile\fi
\ifdefined\GraphFixtureRulePlacement\GraphFixtureRulePlacement\fi
\begin{document}
\ifdefined\GraphFixtureBody\GraphFixtureBody\fi
\ifdefined\GraphFixtureIntro
\GraphPair{reader-guide}{Intro priority rule: inspect choices in order, stop at the first match, and clarify an undecidable earlier choice.\StudyGraphFirstMatch}
\fi
\GraphPair{legend}{\StudyGraphLegendItem{question}{Choose from the stated conditions.}\StudyGraphLegendItem{action}{Perform the stated solution steps.}\StudyGraphLegendItem{warning}{Resolve missing information before proceeding.}}
\StudyGraphNode{choose-task}
\GraphPair{u}{\StudyGraphUncertainty{A required value is unknown.}{The missing value.}{get-value}{Report a value only if all unresolved cases give the same result.}}
\GraphPair{a}{\StudyGraphChoice{1}{Both values are given.}{compute-value}}
\GraphPair{b}{\StudyGraphChoice{2}{A checked total is supplied.}{check-value}}
\ifdefined\GraphFixtureReader
\GraphPair{c}{\StudyGraphCombinedFallback{3}{No earlier condition applies.}{An earlier choice is undecidable.}{Obtain the missing value.}{get-value}{Report only an invariant result.}}
\else
\GraphPair{c}{\StudyGraphFallback{3}{No earlier condition applies.}{get-value}}
\fi
\StudyGraphNode{get-value}
\GraphPair{g1}{\StudyGraphStep{1}{Obtain just the missing value.}}
\GraphPair{gc}{\StudyGraphCompletionCheck{The missing value has been supplied.}}
\GraphPair{gl}{\StudyGraphLoop{The newly obtained value.}{At least one missing fact is now known.}{New facts permit another check.}{Stop if no new fact can be obtained.}\StudyGraphJump{choose-task}}
\StudyGraphNode{compute-value}
\GraphPair{s1}{\StudyGraphStep{1}{Record the two values.}}
\GraphPair{call}{\StudyGraphCall{get-value}{A required value is absent.}{The missing value.}{compute-value}{2}}
\GraphPair{s2}{\StudyGraphStep{2}{Add the two values.}}
\GraphPair{cc}{\StudyGraphCompletionCheck{The total uses both values.}\StudyGraphJump{check-value}}
\StudyGraphNode{check-value}
\GraphPair{check-a}{\StudyGraphChoice{1}{The arithmetic is consistent.}{report-value}}
\GraphPair{check-b}{\StudyGraphFallback{2}{A specific error needs repair.}{compute-value}}
\StudyGraphNode{report-value}
\GraphPair{r1}{\StudyGraphStep{1}{State the result with its units.}\StudyGraphField{result}{The verified result.}\StudyGraphJump{finish}}
\StudyGraphNode{finish}
\GraphPair{end}{The current task is complete.}
